I added a sleep between calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. `test_charges_roundtrip` now waits 0.25s (`REQUEST_INTERVAL_S`) before each request except the first. That keeps it at about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's limit of 5. It adds roughly 0.75s to the test. I haven't run it.

This only spaces out calls within this one test. If other tests in CI hit the same sandbox at the same time, they could still go over the limit together. If that turns out to be the cause, a shared throttle (for example, a fixture) would be the next step.

I also saved a project memory noting the 5 requests-per-second limit, so future work on these tests will take it into account.
